build.buildCommand: cd Backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm --quiet || echo 'spaCy optional'

deploy.startCommand: cd Backend && python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); from main_optimized import app; import uvicorn; uvicorn.run(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=$PORT)"
